gloss: to kick away; to kick hard; to reject

forms.label: Past polite
forms.negative: {蹴飛|けと}ばしませんでした

forms.negative: {蹴飛|けと}ばしていなかった

definitions.gloss: to kick away; to kick hard
definitions.explanation: To kick something or someone forcefully.

definitions.gloss: to reject; to turn down flatly
definitions.explanation: To refuse an offer or proposal dismissively.

examples.japanese: ⟦{邪魔|じゃま}→邪魔：01610_jama⟧⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{石|いし}→石：02177_ishi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{蹴飛|けと}ばした。
examples.english: I kicked away the stone that was in the way.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{高額|こうがく}→高額：14704_kougaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦オファー→オファー：30563_ofaa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{蹴飛|けと}ばした。
examples.english: He turned down the generous offer.

examples.japanese: ⟦{空|あ}き{缶|かん}→空き缶：23052_akikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{蹴飛|けと}ばして⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
examples.english: To walk while kicking an empty can.

examples.japanese: ⟦{布団|ふとん}→布団：01720_futon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{蹴飛|けと}ばして⟦{寝|ね}ている→寝る：00470_neru⟧。
examples.english: He's sleeping with the blanket kicked off.

examples.japanese: ⟦せっかく→折角：04361_sekkaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{昇進|しょうしん}→昇進：04553_shoushin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦チャンス→チャンス：03857_chansu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{蹴飛|けと}ばした。
examples.english: She turned down a rare chance for promotion.

examples.japanese: ⟦{条件|じょうけん}→条件：03285_jouken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{気|き}に{入|い}らなくて→気に入る：02047_kiniiru⟧、⟦{契約|けいやく}→契約：02698_keiyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{蹴飛|けと}ばした。
examples.english: I didn't like the terms, so I rejected the contract.

notes:
FORMS:
Compound verb: ⟦{蹴|け}る→蹴る：02054_keru⟧ (to kick) + ⟦{飛|と}ばす→飛ばす：02373_tobasu⟧ (to send flying). The second half supplies the force — the object does not merely receive a kick, it goes flying.

USAGE:
- ⟦{申|もう}し{出|で}→申し出：13560_moushide⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{蹴飛|けと}ばす (to reject an offer)
- ⟦{提案|ていあん}→提案：03536_teian⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{蹴飛|けと}ばす (to reject a proposal)
- ⟦{布団|ふとん}→布団：01720_futon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{蹴飛|けと}ばす (to kick off the blanket)
Stronger and more physical than plain ⟦{蹴|け}る→蹴る：02054_keru⟧, and distinctly casual. In sense 2 it is a speaker's dismissive characterisation of a refusal — you would not use it in the wording of a formal notice, where ⟦{断|ことわ}る→断る：02102_kotowaru⟧ or ⟦{拒否|きょひ}→拒否：08242_kyohi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ belongs. Saying someone {蹴飛|けと}ばした an offer suggests they threw away something others would have taken.

TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive, taking ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ for the thing kicked or the offer refused. There is no intransitive counterpart; the intransitive image is carried by ⟦{飛|と}ぶ→飛ぶ：00759_tobu⟧ on its own.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{断|ことわ}る→断る：02102_kotowaru⟧ is the neutral verb for declining, usable in any register.
- ⟦{拒否|きょひ}→拒否：08242_kyohi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ is formal refusal, the word of documents and news reports.
